system.description:
Assamites who hone their preternatural senses and speed together learn that it is sometimes wiser to defend than to attack. The character enters a brief trance in which she perceives every threat against her and reacts to each in turn.

At the start of a combat turn, before initiative, the player declares the power's use and spends one Blood Trait and one Willpower Trait; this counts as activating Celerity for the turn. The character takes no offensive action this turn, but may defend against every attack made against her, using a full dodge or parry retest against each one. This power may be used a number of times per scene equal to the character's Alertness rating. Costs 10 Experience Traits to learn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
